messages:
Sasha: quick kickoff — we need to get listings for AWS/GCP/Azure queued this week. I want an owner for packaging, legal artifacts, and pricing SKU mapping.
Frank: I can take packaging (container + AMI). ETA end of week for build + basic manifest.
Emily: I’ll own marketplace legal artifacts with Priya. Need to confirm MSA appendix and security questionnaire answers.
Priya: noted. Can you drop the current answers doc? I’ll fill AWS/GCP/Azure specific clauses.
Sasha: link to our checklist: https://redwood-internal/marketplace/checklist -> follow that template. Main gaps: trial credit flow, logo assets, and support contact.
Frank: for packaging, do we want a single container image and an AMI, or separate flavors per cloud?
Emily: recommend single container image + cloud-specific AMI builder pipeline. reduces catalog churn.
Frank: agree. I’ll add an AMI build step to our CI: packer -> publish AMI per region. example snippet: ```packer build -var 'region=us-west-2' marketplace-ami.json```
Sasha: @Frank add tags: version, build-number, marketplace-catalog-id. We must include SBOM artifact.
Frank: will add SBOM and upload to artifact store.
Priya: legal question: AWS requires DUNS + entity address verification. Do we have that on file for the entity listed?
Emily: yes — legal has DUNS 12-3456789. I’ll attach proof in the doc.
LegalBot: reminder: AML and encryption attestations needed for Azure Marketplace. See https://azure.marketplace/policies.
Sasha: pricing model decision: do we want two SKUs (starter/pro) or a single metered SKU with usage tiers? Thoughts?
Priya: for go-to-market, two SKUs is easier for sales. Metered might pay off later.
Frank: technically both are doable. Starter/pro as separate SKUs reduces portal complexity initially.
Sasha: ok let’s do Starter / Pro. Emily/Priya: can you draft pricing table and trial credit rules? (e.g., 14-day trial, $0 for first 1000 tokens)
Emily: will draft by tomorrow EOD. I’ll include billing contact and support email.
Sasha: ops note — need region availability mapping for Dedicated customers. @Frank can you include regions in AMI release notes?
Frank: yep. will add a small CSV with region -> AMI id.
aws-marketplace-bot: scan complete — no blocking issues found for manifest.json, but missing screenshots (logo + UI).
Sasha: screenshots — motion to use product console screenshots + 1200x800 hero image. @Frank @Emily please coordinate. :thumbsup:
Priya: I’ll schedule a short sync with Marketplace ops team Friday 10am PT to confirm listing timelines. Invite sent.
Sasha: perfect. next steps recap: Frank = packaging + AMI + SBOM + region CSV; Emily = legal artefacts + pricing draft + screenshots; Priya = sync with marketplace ops + billing/legal followups. I’ll run rollout calendar and publish to PMs.
Frank: copied, starting AMI pipeline now.
Emily: attaching initial legal doc in #private: https://redwood-internal/drive/marketplace/legal-draft-v1 (will update).
Sasha: thanks team — aiming to push initial listings to AWS sandbox next Tue. Ping here for blockers.
